newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Life scheme in final stages - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Life scheme in final stages - MOF.

text.p: The process of drawing up a scheme to protect policyholders of failed Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co is in its final stages, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Thursday.

He said he was aware of reports that the ministry and a life insurance group had already hammered out a scheme but added: "As the minister in charge, I can only say the scheme is now in its final stages."

Industry sources said on Wednesday that under a scheme agreed to by the ministry and a life insurance group, a new company would be set up jointly by life insurers to liquidate the failed insurer. The new firm would take Nissan Life's policies and manage them until they mature.
The sources said the framework was expected to be unveiled on Friday at a news conference by the Life Insurance Association of Japan.
